privacy.metaDesc: MarcosLunaDev Privacy Policy. Learn how your personal data is managed, protected and safeguarded on this website.
privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: Last updated: November 19, 2026

s1.title: 1. Data Controller
s1.body:
Owner: Marcos Daniel Luna Rodríguez (private individual)
Location: Madrid, Spain
Contact: info@marcoslunadev.com

This website is the professional portfolio and personal brand of its owner. It does not belong to any company and no products or services are sold through it.

s2.title: 2. What Data Is Processed and Why
s2.body:
Contact form. Name and email (required), phone and company (optional), the service you are interested in and the message you write. They are used to handle and answer your enquiry and, where appropriate, to discuss a possible professional collaboration. After sending it you will receive an automatic confirmation email at the address provided.

Form security. To prevent spam and abuse, Cloudflare Turnstile analyses technical browser signals and your IP address when you reach the form, and the sending server logs technical data (IP, date and time and verification result).

Visiting the website. The hosting service receives the technical connection data (IP address and browser) needed to display the page.

No profiling or automated decision-making takes place, no advertising or newsletters are sent, and data is never sold or shared.

s3.title: 3. Legal Basis
s3.body:
• Contact form: your consent (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR), given by ticking the box and sending the form. You may withdraw it at any time without affecting the lawfulness of prior processing.
  • Security and hosting: the owner's legitimate interest in keeping the website available and protecting the form against abuse (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR).

s4.title: 4. Retention Period
s4.body:
• Contact messages: for as long as needed to reply and at most 12 months from the last communication. If a professional relationship arises from the conversation, they will be kept for its duration and for the applicable legal periods. If you withdraw consent or request erasure, they are deleted.
  • Technical security logs: a few days, according to the provider's configuration.

s5.title: 5. Recipients and Data Processors
s5.body:
Data is not disclosed to third parties unless legally required. The following providers take part in running the website and the form, acting as data processors:

  • Cloudflare, Inc.: server that processes the form (Cloudflare Workers) and anti-bot verification (Turnstile).
  • EmailJS: delivery of the email containing your message and of the confirmation email.
  • The owner's email provider: receipt and storage of messages in the contact mailbox.
  • GitHub, Inc.: website hosting (GitHub Pages).

s6.title: 6. International Transfers
s6.body: Some of these providers are located in the United States or may process data outside the European Economic Area. Such transfers rely on the EU-US Data Privacy Framework where the provider is certified under it or, otherwise, on the standard contractual clauses approved by the European Commission.

s7.title: 7. Minors
s7.body:
This website and its form are intended for adults and professionals. By sending the form you declare that you are over 18 years old. If you are a minor, please do not send your data.

Under Article 7 of Spanish Organic Law 3/2018 (LOPDGDD), children under 14 cannot consent to the processing of their data on their own. If data from a minor is found to have been received, it will be deleted without reply.

s8.title: 8. Your Rights
s8.body:
You may exercise the following rights at any time:

  • Access to your personal data.
  • Rectification of inaccurate data.
  • Erasure of your data.
  • Objection to processing.
  • Restriction of processing.
  • Data portability.
  • Withdrawal of consent, at any time.

To do so, write to info@marcoslunadev.com stating the right you wish to exercise. Additional information will only be requested if there are reasonable doubts about your identity.

If you believe the processing of your data does not comply with the regulations, you may lodge a complaint with the Spanish Data Protection Agency (AEPD) at www.aepd.es.

s9.title: 9. Cookies, Local Storage and Third-Party Resources
s9.body:
This website does not use cookies, whether its own or for analytics, advertising or tracking, so no cookie banner is needed.

It does use the browser's local storage (localStorage) for two features you request, which are exempt from consent under Spanish LSSI (Art. 22.2):

  • preferredLanguage: remembers the language you choose. It remains until you clear your browsing data.
  • mld_contact_last_submit: stores the time of the last form submission to limit repeated submissions.

Cloudflare Turnstile verification is only loaded when you reach the contact form. The website's fonts, icons and libraries are served from its own domain, with no connections to Google Fonts or other external services.

Should cookies requiring consent (for example, analytics) be added in the future, your consent will be requested beforehand through a specific notice.

s10.title: 10. Security
s10.body: Reasonable technical and organisational measures are applied to protect your data: encrypted connection (HTTPS), anti-bot verification, submission limits, restricted access to the mailbox and no proprietary databases storing the messages.

s11.title: 11. Automated Instagram messages
s11.body:
If you comment the word "SPEC" on a post by the Instagram account @marcoslunadev, or send it as a direct message, an automated system sends you a direct message with the link to a free template and, if it was a comment, posts a short reply under it.

  • Data processed: your Instagram username and ID, the text and ID of the comment or message, and its date. Meta provides them through its official Instagram API. No other data is requested, it is not used for advertising and it is not shared with third parties.
  • Purpose: to send you the template you asked for once, and to avoid sending it twice.
  • Legal basis: your consent (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR), given by writing the keyword to request the template.
  • Retention: on the owner's automation server for at most 30 days. After that it is deleted automatically.
  • Providers involved: Meta Platforms Ireland Ltd. (Instagram), which delivers the comments and messages, and ngrok, Inc., which relays Meta's notifications to the owner's server over an encrypted connection.
  • How to delete it sooner: write to info@marcoslunadev.com or send a direct message to @marcoslunadev with the text "DELETE MY DATA". It is deleted within 30 days at most and you will be notified through the same channel.
